pruneIssueTitle: searxng: flip ArgoCD app-searxng prune to true
pruneIssueBody:
## Finding
The `searxng` ArgoCD Application was adopted with `syncPolicy.automated.prune: false` to be safe on first deploy (PRs #373, #374).

## Current state
`prune: false` in `2-k3s/11.argocd/apps/app-searxng.yaml`. Resources deleted from git are not pruned automatically.

## Desired outcome
Flip to `prune: true` so removed resources reconcile away, matching the other adopted apps.

## Notes
Spyros opted to flip now rather than wait the full soak window. `searxng-secret` is SOPS-sourced and ArgoCD-tracked via the ksops generator, so prune is safe once the app is verified Synced. Same flip pattern as the filebrowser app (#52).
fetchIssueTitle: searxng/pi: add fetch_url tool to the web_search extension
fetchIssueBody:
## Finding
The pi `web_search` extension returns title/url/snippet only; reading a full page relies on the model driving `bash`+`curl`.

## Current state
`~/.pi/agent/extensions/searxng-web-search/` registers `web_search` only. `fetch_url` was scoped out of v1.

## Desired outcome
Add a `fetch_url` tool (fetch a URL, strip HTML to readable text, truncate) so the model can read a result page directly after `web_search`.

## Notes
TDD with `node --test`. The extension directory is not in git, so no PR. Deferred (YAGNI) from the initial build; doing it now.
